title: Route claims, test-oracle independence, and consumer-path reconciliation
mode: Primary-source project documentation/test review and local plan audit
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Broaden the DWG/DXF peer screen across project declarations, test routes, and downstream consumer routes
Separate operation-specific read/write/convert claims from source declarations and native acceptance
Identify when a peer test composes with an external converter or performs a lossy projection
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 and FreeCAD composed evidence gates without creating duplicate findings
Preserve scratch-only fixture policy and reduced local validation cadence

sources.name: LibreDWG current README and test scripts
sources.observed: The current README describes a reader that covers DWG versions but may skip advanced R2010+ objects; it describes DWG writing as generally working through R2004, excludes R2007, and notes R2010-R2018 CRC concerns. It states approximate dwg2dxf/dxf2dwg coverage and version scope. test-dxf.sh filters converted DXF and compares it with a paired corpus DXF where available. dxf-roundtrip.sh composes LibreDWG conversion with ODA File Converter and a subsequent DWG read.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Mutable project declarations and test method, not a release-pinned result for every object; the ODA roundtrip path is not open-source-only or an independent ACIS semantic oracle.

sources.name: IxMilia.Dxf direction-specific compatibility declarations
sources.observed: The README declares DXF R10-R2014 support with entity exceptions and separately lists written entity classes or required-field combinations that may not be accepted by AutoCAD.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Self-published DXF scope and caveats, not a DWG result, native run, or per-entity libdxfrw qualification.

sources.name: ezdxf XREF, ACIS, and recovery boundaries
sources.observed: The XREF copy/import API explicitly ignores unsupported entities and document features without raising; this is a projection operation distinct from core document parsing. ACIS support remains profile-limited, while recovery is documented separately from strict parsing.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project documentation of API behavior; no executable or drawing was run in this pass.

sources.name: FreeCAD selectable DXF importer and DWG conversion routes
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents distinct C++ and Python legacy DXF importers with different object coverage, states that stock import cannot read embedded ACIS solids, and routes DWG through a converter before the selected DXF importer.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Current documentation/source route inspection; no Linux or Windows FreeCAD qualification was executed.

sources.name: LibreCAD_3 downstream DWG policy
sources.observed: LibreCAD_3 documents experimental/read-only DWG import through its bundled libdxfrw and no DWG writer commitment.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Downstream product policy and compatibility route, not an independent parser or writer result.

sources.name: Open CASCADE official ACIS component boundary
sources.observed: Open CASCADE identifies SAT/SAB ACIS import/export as a commercial component distinct from the open-source default data-exchange formats.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Vendor component availability/licensing disclosure; it does not establish any local ACIS parser or kernel result.

localEvidence: The existing PAR-07/S8 evidence ledger already separates entity shell, inline/AcDs carrier, owner association, output closure, semantic interpretation, and consumer acceptance; this review sharpens route metadata and evidence tiers rather than creating another owner.

The current FreeCAD checkpoint already treats DWG conversion and DXF import as separate stages; pinning the actual importer/settings is needed because the two documented backends have different coverage.
The existing local implementation cadence calls for generated fast controls, touched strict target, owning CTest, and scoped diff checks, with peer/native work deferred to composed checkpoints.

existingOwners: existing modeler/AcDs and downstream compatibility owners
assessment.planImpact: Refines PAR-07/S8 and the existing FreeCAD gate with exact route identity, operation/direction/version, backend/settings, source/output identity and owner closure, explicit omissions, and distinct evidence tiers. Uses the intended/default FreeCAD route as the required composed case; a second importer is conditional on being an intended product route or useful diagnosis. ACIS remains a separate profile-bounded semantic route; stock open-source OCCT is not an ACIS importer. No new mandatory peer lane, finding, fixture, dependency, or support claim is introduced.

method.kind: Read-only web research and local plan inspection
method.limitations: Mutable project documentation and self-reported issue/test evidence establish only the cited route and revision. No behavior was independently executed, and no conclusion establishes a new libdxfrw defect or support promotion.
